question: _______ was a star of the Kathak dance form described as ‘Nritya Samragini’ (the empress of dance) by Rabindranath Tagore.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitara Devi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sitara Devi** was a renowned Indian Kathak dancer.
 
• She was described as 'Nritya Samragini' (the empress of dance) by Rabindranath Tagore.
 
• Sitara Devi is celebrated for her significant contributions to the classical dance form of Kathak.
 
• Her performances were known for their energy, grace, and intricate footwork.
 
• She was instrumental in popularizing Kathak both in India and internationally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitara Devi** was born in 1920 and started learning dance at a very young age.
 
• She was honored with several awards, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Padma Shri.
 
• Sitara Devi's legacy continues to inspire many young dancers in the field of Kathak.
 
• She passed away in 2014, leaving behind a rich heritage of dance and culture.
